guide.text: Increases nearby allies' Attack and Physical and Spiritual Defense when Green Lantern casts his Ultimate. His Ultimate provides group healing and converts excess healing into shields, and with the Starheart Staff's bonuses, the squad gains healing, shields, Attack, Physical Defense, and Spiritual Defense bonuses all at once.
Buffs nearby allies with extra Attack and Physical Defense whenever Batgirl casts her Ultimate, perfectly matching her drone-based healing and crit support role.

Increases nearby allies' Attack and Physical and Spiritual Defense when Captain Cold casts his Ultimate. Since his Ultimate makes enemies take more physical damage, this staff helps physical squads capitalize on this window.

Increases nearby allies' Attack and Physical and Spiritual Defense when Black Canary casts her Ultimate. Since her Ultimate silences enemies, this staff helps your squad land fatal blows during this window.

Increases nearby allies' Attack and Physical and Spiritual Defense when Starfire casts her Ultimate. Since her Ultimate creates an energy field that provides damage reduction, this staff lets the squad gain damage reduction, Attack, Physical Defense, and Spiritual Defense bonuses all at once.

Increases nearby allies' Attack and Physical and Spiritual Defense when Conner Kent casts his Ultimate. Since his Ultimate boosts allies' Attack and grants control immunity, this staff makes [Superman Family] allies receive double Attack bonuses.

Increases nearby allies' Attack and Physical and Spiritual Defense when Krypto casts his Ultimate. His Ultimate heals allies and reduces enemy Attack in his path, and with this staff's bonuses, the squad becomes tougher and gains Attack, Physical Defense, and Spiritual Defense bonuses all at once.

Increases nearby allies' Attack and Physical and Spiritual Defense when The Riddler casts his Ultimate. Since his Ultimate grants shields to all allies, this staff lets the squad gain shields, Attack, Physical Defense, and Spiritual Defense bonuses all at once.
Increases Attack and healing done, greatly improving Hal Jordan's healing and shield conversion while giving the squad a stronger shield at battle start.
